name: iteriodev_turnview
description: Control panel of the Turn View tool (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8): the front camera in the cluster (iDrive 8: its widget, iDrive 7: the map view in the centre) with a blue turn sign near each turn, or on the head unit instead (the Camera page, any speed); on cars with BMW Night Vision its picture instead of the front camera (Camera page: Night Vision); on / off, status, camera calibration; asks the camera ECU for the front view when no other app does; talks to the tool over its control socket; GPU renderer screens
author: IterioDev

store.description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with a turn card and, near each turn, a blue turn sign (three chevrons pointing the way), from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. Or on the head unit instead: the Camera button opens the camera's whole picture with the same card and sign, at any speed (Picture on: Head unit), for kerbs and tight gaps. Cars with BMW Night Vision (1.7.0): Camera Night Vision shows its picture instead, in the cluster or here (read from the head unit's own video input; BMW's Night Vision screen then stays black). iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: off at every start of the car; switch it on in this app and set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view. Do not use it together with Waze on cluster on the cluster: set Waze on cluster to HUD only (the cluster and the HUD show 2 videos at most). Calibrate the camera once on a straight road. Needs the Turn View tool from the same source and Cluster renderer from robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps (0.5.10 or newer). Does not need Drive Recorder.
